description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions for handling RLC AM Protocol Data Units (PDUs), including headers and status PDUs, with support for serialization and deserialization, as well as formatting for debugging.

classes.name: rlc_am_status_pdu
classes.description: Represents an RLC AM Status Protocol Data Unit, managing NACKs, packing/unpacking, and merging logic.

methods.name: rlc_am_pdu_header::get_packed_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the header based on segmentation info and sequence number size.

methods.name: rlc_am_status_pdu::reset
methods.description: Resets the status PDU to its initial state.

methods.name: rlc_am_status_pdu::can_be_merged
methods.description: Checks if two NACKs can be merged into a single NACK.

methods.name: rlc_am_status_pdu::push_nack
methods.description: Adds a NACK to the status PDU.

methods.name: rlc_am_status_pdu::pack
methods.description: Serializes the status PDU into a buffer.

methods.name: rlc_am_status_pdu::unpack
methods.description: Deserializes a status PDU from a buffer.

methods.name: rlc_am_read_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Reads and parses an RLC AM data PDU header from a byte buffer view.

methods.name: rlc_am_write_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes an RLC AM data PDU header into a buffer.
